correctness.rationale: For any positive tree edge probabilities the Kemeny spectral sum is exactly (1/N) times the sum of component-size products divided by edge weights; strict convexity yields unrestricted uniqueness and arm symmetry. A direct KKT multiplier certificate verifies all active/slack vertex caps for \(k\ge3\), \(L\ge3\), using monotone \(c_j\) and strictly increasing ratios \(c_{2i}/c_{2i+1}\). Explicit coefficient sums prove the sharp asymptotic objective and \(k/2\) comparator. Extracted verify.py independently checks 5684 exact-inequality pairs and 60 spectral matrix cases; finite checks support but do not replace the all-size proof.

value.rationale: Equal-length spider trees are natural multi-route transport networks. Exact active-set determination for every number of arms and each path length is a nonroutine structural optimizer result. Unlike numerical SDP outputs, the theorem identifies a unique depth-one holding junction and all other active constraints with an explicit formula; its \(k/2\) asymptotic ratio shows that maximum-degree equal-edge conductances can be arbitrarily suboptimal as hub degree grows. The precise all-size network design and its degree-dependent penalty motivate this invariant.
